text:
alex_w: Hey team — quick follow-up from Claire at ACME. They want: 1) hosted API audit evidence for the POC (who accessed keys, timestamps, token rotation), 2) options to stream POC logs into their SIEM (Splunk or S3), and 3) a short summary of what we can provide from Dedicated/VPC if they escalate. Claire, tagging you so we don't miss anything.

claire_acme: Thanks Alex. Prefer Splunk HEC but we can accept S3 if easier. Need retention proof for 90 days and proof that keys used during demo are ephemeral. Also security questionnaire asks about rotation policy.

maria_s: Got it. For Hosted POC we can provide: audit log export (signed daily bundle), access log CSV for API keys, and a short-lived API key option (ephemeral tokens 1h). We don't have automatic Splunk HEC from hosted by default but we can deliver S3+signed URL that they can ingest.

jonathan_h: For Dedicated/Dedicated-dev pools we can enable direct syslog/HEC forwarding from the cluster network if customer provides HEC endpoint and a peering/VPN. For Private (VPC) we can set up agent-based forwarder inside their VPC to push to Splunk.

samir_r: Security note: hosted signed daily bundle will include authentication events (key id, actor, action), but not raw customer prompts. We can provide an evidence manifest with hashes if ACME wants non-repudiation. Rotation policy: ephemeral demo keys rotate every hour by default; long-lived keys require admin request and are logged.

alex_w: Claire — is S3 ingestion acceptable if we provide a signed S3 export and a sample manifest for ingestion? Also they'll want a one-pager describing log fields for compliance.

claire_acme: S3 is fine as long as we get the manifest and they can confirm ingestion to Splunk. Also need an example of the daily bundle and the retention policy written up for their security team.

maria_s: Copying sample manifest below. It's a tiny JSONL schema we use for evidence exports. You can pass this straight to your SIEM parser or use the Splunk S3 connector.

```
{
  "bundle_id": "bundle-2026-03-21-0001",
  "exported_at": "2026-03-21T10:00:00Z",
  "records": [
    {"ts":"2026-03-21T09:59:12Z","event":"auth","key_id":"demo-abc123","actor":"cli","result":"success"},
    {"ts":"2026-03-21T09:59:18Z","event":"generation","model":"redwood-v1","tokens_in":12,"tokens_out":48}
  ]
}
```

maria_s: And example curl to fetch the signed S3 export (signed URL valid 24h):

```
curl -L "https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-poc-bundles/bundle-2026-03-21-0001.jsonl?X-Amz-Signature=..." -o acme-poc-bundle.jsonl
```

jonathan_h: If ACME wants Splunk HEC streaming from Dedicated, we'll need network details and a temporary cert or HEC token. Ops team can spin up forwarder inside the dedicated pool. Estimate ~3 business days to wire.

samir_r: For the security questionnaire, I'll produce two short answers: one for Hosted POC (what we can supply today) and one for Dedicated/VPC (what's available with customer-provided endpoint and peering). Will include rotation policy, retention windows, and list of log fields.

alex_w: Action items: 1) Maria — create one-pager + sample manifest and curl example (due EOD). 2) Samir — draft Qs answers for the questionnaire (tomorrow). 3) Jonathan — time estimate for Dedicated HEC forwarder (3bd) and list of network requirements. 4) Claire — confirm S3 ingestion or request HEC, and confirm retention requirement (90 days).

maria_s: On it. I'll attach the one-pager to this thread when ready. :thumbsup:

claire_acme: Confirm S3 + manifest is fine. Please state that the signed bundle contains only metadata and operational logs, no customer prompt payloads for privacy.

samir_r: Affirmed — we'll call that out explicitly in the evidence doc and include a hash manifest if they want to verify integrity. :lock:

ops-bot: deploy-log-exporter-job started for poc-bucket at 2026-03-21T10:12:34Z (job id: export-1935-01).

alex_w: Great — thanks everyone. I'll loop in renewal AE if they want Dedicated after POC.

claire_acme: Thanks team, this helps a lot.
